semiconductor_relevance: High — Tsukuba Power Electronics Constellations focuses on innovating power electronics using wide-bandgap semiconductors, which are critical in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Tsukuba Power Electronics Constellations (TPEC) is a collaborative research group that aims to advance power electronics through open innovation, particularly utilizing wide-bandgap semiconductors like SiC and GaN. Established in 2012, TPEC conducts integrated research across various aspects of power electronics, including materials, devices, and modules.
capabilities: High-speed polishing materials for SiC wafers
